question.problem: What is the domain in the $xy$-plane of the elliptic cylinder $\frac{{x}^{2}}{25}+\frac{(y-3)^{2}}{9}=1?$

choices.value: An ellipse centered at $(0,-3)$ with semi-axes of lengths $5$ and $3.$
An ellipse centered at $(0,-3)$ with semi-axes of lengths $25$ and $9.$
The interior and boundary of an ellipse centered at $(0,-3)$ with semi-axes of lengths $25$ and $9.$
An ellipse centered at $(0,3)$ with semi-axes of lengths $5$ and $3.$
The interior and boundary of an ellipse centered at $(0,3)$ with semi-axes of lengths $5$ and $3.$
